description: Nút nhích sang phải 9 px, lùi 3 px rồi về chỗ, một lần, để gợi ý bấm.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio nudge, written here): x keys 0 → +9 px (180 ms) → −3 px (330 ms) → 0 (520 ms), sine.inOut between keys; only the target moves (a 'Next' button), once. Same preset family: styles nod, jelly, hop, tilt (one preset with a style param, like text/land-in). Params: amp (9 px) · back (3 px) · duration (0.52 s).
